findings: 3 losses closed, all the same XRP-USD position time-exiting at 24h: main -65.89 (gross -21.13, fees 44.77) and the hourly-legacy/lab-hourly copies -72.21 each (gross -38.77, fees 33.43). So a positive 24h change did NOT protect these trades. The repeated failure is the aggressive 2.5x ATR stop with 1.5R target: it puts targets about 7-8% away, which the market has not reached in 24h on any losing trade.

Hypothesis tested (failed): a 24h momentum gate (buy only if the close is above the close 24h ago). Walk-forward, train / validation / unseen. Hourly aggressive rules without the gate: 97t 29% -2087 / 55t 15% -2337 / 66t 27% -2685. With the gate: 57t 25% -1297 / 23t 0% -1590 / 33t 9% -1895. It loses less only by trading half as much, and the win rate falls. Scout: 13t 46% -8 unseen without the gate, 0t with it. Not adopted; code reverted.

Hypothesis tested (failed): a smaller target for the hourly rules (0.6R instead of 1.5R, same stop). Unseen 72t 29% -2440 vs 66t 27% -2685. Win rate rises only 2 points; still deeply negative after fees.
Overall: the aggressive hourly rules lose about $2.7k per 8 days per $10k at 2% risk on unseen data. They stay as challenger evidence only; nothing like them should reach the main account.
